status_vocabulary.DESIGNATED_PENDING_ANCHOR: named by the person concerned in the design instruction; binding only when that person commits, tags and pushes this amendment
status_vocabulary.SOFTWARE_REGISTERED_PENDING_ANCHOR: code frozen by digest in this amendment; binding on remote anchoring
status_vocabulary.FROZEN_DOCUMENT_PENDING_ANCHOR: document frozen by digest in this amendment
status_vocabulary.UNFILLED: required and not registered; every gate that needs it stays CLOSED
status_vocabulary.FUTURE_STAGE: required at a later freeze; recorded so it cannot be forgotten

registration_mechanism: A slot is filled only by a schema-valid record committed under an annotated tag whose peeled commit is on origin before the slot's first gate. Records are append-only and frozen after first use. A human slot may not be filled by a model, a process or a person already holding a conflicting role.
